title: 第十三章五行筑基第十四章 临海城

秦枫将自己关在静室之中，整整一月，没有任何动静。
这一月里，他什么也没做，只是静静地坐着，回想着云鼎山脉发生的一切，内心的悲凉如狂风，扫过原本平静而清澈的心湖，一声叹息：＂人心何其复杂＂。他的心灵，受到了前所未有的冲击。他终于明白，木秀于林，风必摧之的道理，这个世界，远比他想象中要残酷得多。所谓的亲情、友情，在绝对的利益和阴谋面前，有时是如此的脆弱。
一月后，老祖出现在了他的静室之中。
秦枫缓缓抬起头，看着老祖，嘴唇动了动，最终只是哽咽着说出了四个字：“老祖……对不起……”
老祖看着他眼中那一闪而过的迷茫和痛苦，心中微微一叹。他伸出手，轻轻拍了拍秦枫的肩膀，语气柔和地说道：“小枫，你没有错。”
他顿了顿，目光变得悠远起来道：“人对现实的认知，对世界的认知，是需要用代价来获得的。”
“你要记住——”老祖的声音变得严肃起来，“在这个世界上，没有实力，就是原罪。”
秦枫默然，眼中的迷茫渐渐散去，取而代之的，是一种前所未有的坚毅。他知道，自己必须变得更强！秦枫的眼神中，慢慢的多了一丝与年龄不符的沧桑和锐利。
一晃几个月过去。秦枫依旧是那个秦枫，脸上依旧会露出笑容，依旧会和家人、朋友说笑。但所有人都知道，他已经不再是以前那个无忧无虑、天真烂漫的少年了。
他的心，已经悄然改变。……
这一日，秦枫正在晨露苑中，帮父母打理菜园。
阳光温暖地洒在身上，空气中弥漫着泥土和花草的清香，一切都显得那么宁静而祥和。秦枫弯着腰，小心翼翼地给菜苗浇水，脸上带着淡淡的笑容。一点不像一个修仙者。
瑞安王和王妃站在不远处，看着儿子的背影，眼中充满了欣慰。
就在这时，一道细微的传音，悄然传入秦枫的耳中。“小枫，来我这里一趟。”是老祖的声音。秦枫浇水的动作微微一顿，随即直起身来。
他回房间，简单地收拾了一下衣物，然后静静地站在菜园边，看着田垄间的父母。
瑞安王和王妃似乎也感应到了什么，他们抬起头，看了看秦枫，脸上露出了一丝不舍，但很快便被笑容取代。
瑞安王挥了挥手，笑道：“枫儿，安心去吧。记住，无论你走到哪里，晨露苑，永远是你的归宿。”
王妃也点了点头，眼中含着泪，却笑着说道：“去吧，孩子。好好修炼，照顾好自己。”
秦枫重重地点了点头，对着父母深深鞠了一躬，然后转身离去。他的身影，很快便消失在了晨露苑的门口。秦枫知道，这一次离开，又不知要多久，才能再次回到晨露苑，陪伴自己渐渐年老的父母。

他来到了老祖的闭关之地。老祖早已在静室中等候。看到秦枫进来，老祖满意地点了点头：“准备好了吗？”
秦枫深吸一口气，眼神坚定地说道：“准备好了，老祖！”
老祖满意地点点头：“很好。随我来。”
秦枫随老祖踏入静室后方的密道。密道狭窄而幽暗，两侧的石壁冰冷刺骨。不知走了多久，当他们走出密道时，眼前的景象非常熟悉。这里，竟是玉龙秘境！
秦枫心中震撼。他没想到，紫徽大殿与玉龙秘境之间，竟然还有这样一条隐秘的通道。他随老祖很快来到那间熟悉的石屋。石屋内依旧简陋，墙壁上摆放着一排排盛放灵药的瓶瓶罐罐。只是，原本只有一个的浴缶，如今却变成了两个。秦翊早已在屋内等候。看到老祖，他连忙恭敬行礼，随后便兴奋地冲过来，一把搂住秦枫的肩膀，笑嘻嘻道：“小枫，你可算来了！我等你好久了！”
秦枫也被他的情绪感染，心中的沉重稍稍散去。
这时，老祖开始忙碌起来。他先是将一瓶红色的液体倒入浴缶中，一股浓烈的腥气瞬间弥漫开来，让人闻之欲呕。

Qin Feng locked himself in a quiet room, and there was no movement for a whole month.
During this month, he did nothing but sat quietly, recalling everything that happened in the Yunding Mountains. The sadness in his heart was like a strong wind, sweeping across the originally calm and clear lake of his heart, and he sighed: "The human heart is so complicated." His mind was hit like never before. He finally understood that the wind will destroy the trees that are as beautiful as the trees in the forest. This world is far more cruel than he imagined. The so-called family love and friendship are sometimes so fragile in the face of absolute interests and conspiracies.
One month later, the ancestor appeared in his quiet room.
Qin Feng slowly raised his head, looked at his ancestor, moved his lips, and finally choked out four words: "Ancestor... I'm sorry..."
The ancestor looked at the flash of confusion and pain in his eyes and sighed slightly in his heart. He reached out his hand, patted Qin Feng's shoulder gently, and said softly: "Xiao Feng, you are not wrong."
He paused, his eyes became distant and said: "People's understanding of reality and the world needs to be obtained at a price."
"You have to remember -" the ancestor's voice became serious, "in this world, not having strength is the original sin."
Qin Feng was silent, the confusion in his eyes gradually dissipated, replaced by an unprecedented perseverance. He knows that he must become stronger! Qin Feng's eyes gradually gained a trace of vicissitudes and sharpness that did not match his age.
Months passed in a flash. Qin Feng is still the same Qin Feng, he still has a smile on his face, and he still laughs with his family and friends. But everyone knows that he is no longer the carefree and innocent boy he used to be.
His heart has quietly changed. …
On this day, Qin Feng was helping his parents take care of the vegetable garden in Chenlu Garden.
The sun shines warmly on the body, and the air is filled with the fragrance of earth and flowers. Everything seems so quiet and peaceful. Qin Feng bent over and carefully watered the vegetable seedlings with a faint smile on his face. Not at all like a cultivator.
King Ruian and his wife stood not far away, looking at their son's back, their eyes filled with relief.
At this moment, a subtle sound transmission quietly reached Qin Feng's ears. "Xiao Feng, come to my place." It was the voice of the ancestor. Qin Feng's watering action paused slightly, then straightened up.
He went back to his room, briefly packed his clothes, and then stood quietly by the vegetable garden, looking at his parents in the fields.
King Ruian and Princess seemed to sense something. They raised their heads and looked at Qin Feng, with a trace of reluctance on their faces, but it was quickly replaced by a smile.
King Ruian waved his hand and said with a smile: "Feng'er, go in peace. Remember, no matter where you go, Chenlu Garden will always be your destination."
The princess also nodded, with tears in her eyes, but said with a smile: "Go, child. Practice well and take care of yourself."
Qin Feng nodded heavily, bowed deeply to his parents, then turned and left. His figure quickly disappeared at the door of Chenlu Garden. Qin Feng knew that after leaving this time, he didn't know how long it would take before he could return to Chenlu Garden again to accompany his parents who were getting older.
He came to the retreat place of his ancestor. The ancestor has already been waiting in the quiet room. Seeing Qin Feng come in, the ancestor nodded with satisfaction: "Are you ready?"
Qin Feng took a deep breath and said with firm eyes: "Get ready, ancestor!"
The ancestor nodded with satisfaction: "Very good. Come with me."
Qin Feng followed his ancestor into the secret passage behind the quiet room. The secret passage is narrow and dark, and the stone walls on both sides are bitingly cold. I don't know how long they walked, but when they walked out of the secret passage, the scene in front of them was very familiar. This is actually the Jade Dragon Secret Realm!
Qin Feng was shocked. He did not expect that there was such a secret passage between the Zihui Hall and the Jade Dragon Secret Realm. He followsThe ancestor soon arrived at the familiar stone house. The stone house is still simple, with rows of bottles and jars containing elixirs placed on the walls. However, there was originally only one bathing fou, but now there are two. Qin Yi was already waiting in the house. Seeing the ancestor, he quickly saluted respectfully, then rushed over excitedly, hugged Qin Feng's shoulders, and said with a smile: "Xiao Feng, you're finally here! I've been waiting for you for a long time!"
Qin Feng was also infected by his emotions, and the heaviness in his heart dissipated slightly.
At this time, the ancestor started to get busy. He first poured a bottle of red liquid into the bathing vessel, and a strong fishy smell instantly filled the air, making people nauseous.
